newsitem.title: USA: GPU to shut 79 MW Pa. unit for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: GPU to shut 79 MW Pa. unit for maintenance.

text.p: GPU Generation Inc will shut a 79 megawatt unit at the Titus coal-fired facility near Redding, Pa., late Friday for scheduled maintenance, the company said today.
"It's scheduled for turbine maintenance midnight tonight," a company spokeswoman said, adding the unit was set to startup November 11.
The Titus facility has two other units with a combined capacity of 160 MW.
Titus is operated by GPU Generation and owned by Met-Ed/Penelec. Both companies are subsidiaries of General Public Utilities Corp of Parsippany, N.J.
